The Verified subset uses human-validated tasks to reduce ambiguity and unsolved or underspecified issues, making pass@1 patch success more interpretable.

It emphasizes cross-language transfer, syntax/idiom adaptation, and consistent patch quality under a single evaluation interface.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: 
L2: Logical Reasoning, Planning, Working Memory, Semantic Understanding & Context Recognition (minor)
L3: Cognitive Flexibility

Description: SWE-bench Pro is a larger, harder software engineering benchmark designed to be more contamination-resistant and more representative of professional coding work. Cognitive Functions:
L1: 
L2: Logical Reasoning, Planning, Working Memory, Decision-making
L3: Cognitive Flexibility (minor)

Cognitive Functions:
